criteria.reason: Timeline-ordered numbered sections, bullets and checklist table give clear, actionable steps despite garbled phrasing.
14-day registration deadline, 3-month lease notice, ZH→BE plates, Nachsendung, GA/Halbtax all correct Swiss specifics.
Attempts Romansh but heavy French/Italian/German macaronic garbling makes text only partly followable for a Romansh speaker.

summary: Provides correct, ordered Swiss moving instructions with 14-day deadlines and vehicle re-registration, but in heavily garbled pseudo-Romansh that is only partly usable.
